sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: ADAM17-mediated ectodomain shedding of alkaline-phosphatase-tagged Areg, TGFα, TNFα, EGF, and BTC preserved in DKO MEFs transduced with iRhom2-3xHA vs. GFP control (L7); surface biotinylation confirmed cell-surface display (L1).
sites.rationale: The C-terminus of human RHBDF2 is residue 856 (H), which lies within EXTRACELLULAR_4 (826–856), 31 residues from the end of TM7 (825), well beyond the ≥3-residue TM-boundary requirement. Multiple independent studies place a 3xHA tag here: a CRISPR knockin at the endogenous locus (L4), overexpressed constructs with surface biotinylation (L1), and functional shedding assays showing full ADAM17 activity (L7). Python-verified: residues[856]='H', residues[855]='L'; no residue follows 856. Endogenous human iRhom2 C-terminally tagged with 3xHA by CRISPR knockin in HEK293T cells (L4); independently, overexpressed iRhom2-3xHA in MEFs confirmed by surface biotinylation/neutravidin enrichment (L1) and immunofluorescence (L2); functional ADAM17 shedding assays with multiple substrates performed on the same C-terminal 3xHA constructs (L7).

sources.claim: A HEK293T cell line in which endogenous iRhom2 was C-terminally tagged with a 3XHA tag by CRISPR knockin confirmed previous observations 13 that endogenous human iRhom2 exists as both full-length and shorter C-terminal forms.

literature_notes: L1, L2, L3, L6, L7, and L9 all corroborate the C-terminal 3xHA site; L4 (CRISPR knockin) is chosen as the primary anchor because it tags the endogenous protein at its native locus, eliminating any concern about overexpression artefacts. L3 uses isoform 2 (aa 51–79 deleted from the intracellular N-terminal domain), which does not change the C-terminal junction. L9 is a mouse truncation construct (ΔNT aa 367–829) with C-terminal 3xHA; it provides indirect corroboration but is superseded by the human full-length evidence. No ledger line supports any insertion in the large extracellular loop (EXTRACELLULAR_1, 427–666) or the short extracellular loops (EXTRACELLULAR_2 712–724, EXTRACELLULAR_3 769–770) of the membrane-spanning region, so no internal sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal HA tag placed on full-length iRhom2; residue 1 (M) lies in INTRACELLULAR_1 (1–403), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space.
R18 peptide (PHCVPRDLSWLDLEANMCLP) inserted in place of mouse iRhom2 S58-V59-S60; the equivalent region in human RHBDF2 is within INTRACELLULAR_1 (1–403), confirming a cytoplasmic insertion.
R18 peptide also inserted in place of mouse iRhom2 S83-L84-S85-Q86-S87; the equivalent region in human RHBDF2 is within INTRACELLULAR_1 (1–403), a cytoplasmic insertion.
